annotations.title: Find coupon codes for a store

description: Use this when the user wants a coupon, promo, discount or voucher code for a specific online store or brand, or shares a store's website or product page URL and asks about saving on it. Accepts a store name ("Airwheel Luggage"), a domain ("airwheel-luggage.com") or a full product URL. Returns up to 3 matching stores, each with the code, the discount, how to apply it, minimum order if any, an affiliate shop link and the Whale Coupons store page. If no store has that name the result says so (found=false); when the words describe a product, stores that sell it may be returned instead (match="product"). Never invent or guess a code. Covers thousands of independent online stores, updated daily; large general marketplaces are not covered. For a product type rather than a store (e.g. "headphones") use search_stores. Do not use for price comparison, product reviews, order tracking or buying on the user's behalf.

store.description: Store or brand name, website domain, or a product/store page URL, exactly as the user gave it. Examples: "Saguaro Barefoot Shoes", "saguaro.com", "https://www.saguaro.com/products/...". Do not add words like 'coupon' or 'code'.

name: find_coupons

match.description: exact/partial: store name or website matched; product: no store with that name, results are stores whose own catalog lists that product.

shop_link.description: Affiliate link to the store (opens the store with the discount).

suggested_category.description: When no store matched but the query looks like a product type: the closest category to use with search_stores.

title: Find coupon codes for a store
